profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer | .NET & Angular | UI/UX & DevOps | 15+ Years of Software Engineering Excellence
profile.summary:
As a Senior Full-Stack Developer with 15+ years of experience, I specialize in designing and delivering high-impact software solutions in the Medical Health Plan industry. My work spans the full development lifecycle—from UI/UX design and database modeling to DevOps implementation and production support. I am passionate about building scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly systems that truly improve workflows and outcomes for both users and stakeholders.

Throughout my career, I’ve taken on complex technical challenges and delivered measurable results. At Communith Health Group, I’ve led the development of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) modules, built health evaluation tools, and introduced security and analytics enhancements across web platforms. I’ve also implemented Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and championed code quality through tools like SonarQube.

I take a user-centered approach to software, blending technical execution with thoughtful design. My certifications in UX Design and Azure DevOps, along with a Diplomado in Artificial Intelligence and Business, help me bring modern, strategic thinking to every project.

In previous roles, I’ve:

- Automated long form submissions with Selenium
- Led the development of a multi-tier Kanban system that reduced setup time from 3 months to 30 minutes
- Migrated legacy applications and built desktop tools with offline capabilities
- Developed Microsoft Dynamics CRM customizations and internal Java tools

I’m also known for being a supportive team member—mentoring junior developers, onboarding new hires, and providing feedback that improves collaboration across teams. I’ve consistently been recognized for my adaptability, attention to detail, and willingness to go the extra mile to meet deadlines.

I’m committed to continuous learning and staying ahead of evolving technologies. My goal is to keep growing as a software engineer and continue delivering digital solutions that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
- Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable full-stack code using .NET and Angular technologies
- Integrate data storage solutions and ensure performant access with MS SQL and SSIS
- Identify and resolve system bottlenecks and bugs to maintain platform stability and responsiveness
- Create high-fidelity mockups and user interface designs using Figma
- Implement and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and release configurations to streamline deployment
- Support both front-end and back-end feature development using TypeScript, jQuery, and Twitter Bootstrap
- Contribute to consistent code organization and automation across the development lifecycle
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps (CI/CD Pipelines, Azure DevOps) · UI/UX Design (Figma, consistency, responsiveness) · Angular & TypeScript Development · Healthcare Systems Integration (ECM, NEMT, Case Management) · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, and maintained efficient, reusable, and scalable code using .NET
- Integrated robust data storage solutions and optimized data access using Entity Framework and SQL
- Identified and resolved performance bottlenecks and software bugs across multiple applications
- Helped ensure code quality and maintain organization across team projects
- Designed and led the development of a multi-tier Kanban web platform that consolidated previously siloed Kanban boards into a unified system
- Reduced deployment time from 3 months per Kanban board to a 30-minute setup meeting, eliminating the need for separate databases and URLs per board
positions.insights: Skills: Multi-tier Architecture Design · AngularJS & Angular 2 Frontend Development · Workflow Automation (WorkflowGen, SSIS) · .NET MVC & Entity Framework · SQL Optimization

company.name: Turbo Tecnologia de Reparaciones S.A. de C.V (Solar Turbines)

positions.title: Senior .Net Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed both front-end and back-end components for existing web applications
- Added new features and maintained functionality using C#, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and SQL
- Provided ongoing technical support and issue resolution for business-critical applications
- Used Team Foundation Server (TFS) for version control and collaboration
- Built a C# Selenium client to automate the population of long multi-page forms, including functionality to detect the last completed page and resume data entry automatically
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Web Forms & MVC · SQL Query Development & Maintenance · UI Enhancement with jQuery/Bootstrap · Source Control with TFS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained customizations for Microsoft Dynamics CRM to meet specific business needs
- Enhanced existing web applications by implementing new features using C#, ASP.NET, T-SQL, and jQuery
- Delivered stable, scalable CRM and web solutions that improved internal workflows
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Dynamics CRM Customization · ASP.NET Development · jQuery UI Enhancements · SQL Stored Procedures

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed internal web-based user interfaces using Java and ICEfaces
- Supported UI development and integration for internal tools and business processes
- Built a standalone application using Java and Apache Pivot that enabled agents to process payments offline, with automatic data synchronization upon reconnecting to the internet
positions.insights: Skills: Java Application Development · Apache Pivot for Offline Access · ICEfaces Framework · Standalone Desktop Apps

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
- Developed intranet web applications to support daily operations using C#, ASP.NET, and T-SQL
- Migrated legacy applications from C++ Builder to the .NET framework with improved maintainability and usability.

Key Achievements:

- Migrated a lengthy paper-based form to a web-based version, enabling faster submission and easier interpretation by replacing handwritten entries
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET Web App Development · T-SQL for Data Processing · C++ to C# Migration · Form Digitization · Internal Tool Support
